method: R49 previous-match manager continuity from external dated TM game-level manager fields, not target-match manager or current lineup. Source published as bulk retrospective archive; prior match coach is a recoverable prior-event fact, but release timing and historical source completeness unproven. Crown and TM match/team identity via explicit league crosswalk, unique named exact-score-date anchors and one-to-one team ID crosswalk; non-matching rows remain missing. Training excludes actual receipt FIDs and uses earlier calendar years only; exact T12 Crown odds for AH/OU payout. Same sample all variants, no profit-triggered league/week/side filtering and no production gates. TM dataset stops July 6, 2026 so Oct-Nov 2026 receipt retrospective cannot be validated; no substitution or fake real-time availability. Source excludes match on same/preceding two UTC days in coach features. No target score/card/manager in the feature calculation, only historical identity joining.
